XI.|TO THE ROMANES.|411}}</noinclude>nature, shal be graffed into their ovvne oliue? {{verse|chapter=11|verse=25}}† For I vvil not haue you ignorant, brethren, of this mysterie (that you be not vvise in your selues) that blindnes in part hath chaunced in Israël, vntil the fulnes of the Gentiles might enter: {{verse|chapter=11|verse=26}}† and so al Israël might be saued, as it is vvritten: {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Esa. 59, 20.''}}* ''There shal come out of Sion, he that shal deliuer, and shal auert impietie from Iacob''. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=27}}† ''And this to them the testament from me'': vvhen I shal haue taken avvay their sinnes. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=28}}† {{sup|‖}} According to the Gospel in deede enemies for you: but according to the election, most deere for the fathers. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=29}}† for vvithout repentance are the giftes and the vocation of God. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=30}}† {{sup|‖}} for as you also sometime did not beleeue God, but novv haue obteined mercie because of their incredulitie: {{verse|chapter=11|verse=31}}† so these also novv haue not beleeued, for your mercie, that they also may obteine mercie. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=32}}† For God hath {{sup|‖}} concluded al into incredulitie, that he may haue mercie on al. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=33}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Epistle vpō Trinitie Sunday.}}{{sup|‖}} O depth of the riches of the vvisedom and of the knowledge of God: hovv incomprehensible are his iudgements, and his vvaies vnsearcheable? {{verse|chapter=11|verse=34}}† for {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Esa. 40, 13.''}}* vvho hath knovven the minde of our Lord? Or vvho hath been his counseler? {{verse|chapter=11|verse=35}}† Or vvho hath first giuen to him, and retribution shal be made him? {{verse|chapter=11|verse=36}}† For of him, and by him, and in him are al things: to him be glorie for euer. Amen.⊣

{{c|{{larger|A N N O T A T I O N S}}}}
{{c|{{sc|Chap. XI.}}}}

''4. Seuen thousand.''] {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=Gods answer to Elias of 7000, maketh nothing for the Protestants inuisible Church.}}The Heretikes alleage this place and example very impertinently to proue that the Church may be wholy secrete, hid, or vnknovven. for though the faithful were forced to keepe close in that persecution of Achab and Iezabel, which vvas onely in the kingdom of the ten tribes, that is, of Isaael: yet at the very same time, in Hierusalem and al the kingdom of Iuda, the external vvorship and profession of faith vvas open to al the vvorld, and wel knowen to Elias & the faithful, so many, that {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''2. Par. 17.''}}the very souldiers only were numbered aboue ten hundred thousand. besides that there is a great difference betvvene the Christian Church and the Ievves, ours resting vpon better promisses then theirs. And we wil not put the Protestants to proue that there were 7000 of their Sect, when their new Elias Luther began: but let them proue that there were seuen, or any one, either then or in al ages before him, that vvas in al pointes of his beleefe. Heretikes there were before him, as Iouinian, Vigilantius, Heluidius, Wicleffe &c. and with him, Zuinglius, Caluin, &c. Who beleeued as he did in some things, but not in al.

''6. Not novv of vvorkes.''] {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=What Workes are not, & what are the cause of saluation.}}If saluation be attributed to good vvorkes done of nature without faith & Gods helpe, the same can not be of grace. for such workes exclude grace, fauour, and mercie: and chalenge onely of dette, and not of gift. Therfore take heede here of the Heretikes exposition, that vntruely exclude Christian mens vvorkes from necessity or merite of saluation, which are done with and by Gods grace, and therfore euidently consist with the same, and be ioyned with Gods grace as causes of our saluation. Our Aduersaries are like il Potecaries, euer taking ''quid pro quo'', either of ignorance, or of intent to deceiue the simple.<noinclude>{{rh||Fff ij|''8. God''}}</noinclude>
